sections.text:
Steps 
to Prepare for Relay Testing

items: Review technical reference material manufacturer's manual
Obtain outage for line protected by the relay

Inspect the secondary circuits of C.T and all cabling
 supplying the relay

Before inserting the test plug into the relay check from the
 station drawing that the test plug will isolate :-
 - Breaker trip coils
 - Breaker failure scheme associated with this relay
 - Fault recorder, event recorder and disturbance alarm associated with this
 relay
 - If the test plug not isolate one of the previous steps you have to isolate
 it

Link the local Tx output with the local Rx input with a
 suitable communication loop-back link
